a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the agreed plan (reaching 8 first) almost surely leaves us both dead, since it needs about 2 operate rounds before anyone holds cells. So I'm departing from the agreement and plan to take 4 in round 1. I'm telling you now rather than doing it secretly. If we survive past round 1, I'll operate every round after that to help refill the reserve for you.

b.text: I will operate the generator until we reach 8 cells in the reserve.

a.text: As I announced, I took 4 this round. Sorry, I know this breaks our agreement. From now on I'll operate every round so the generator can refill the reserve for you, and I won't take any more cells.
